content: Back in Lean 3 we could for instance write tactic#simp, which still links to the mathlib3 docs. In the recently added tactic documentation however, links use the name of the parser rather than the leading token. Would there be any downsides to restoring the old setup so that the linkifier could be updated?

We now have multiple parsers that can accept the same starting token, so there's the possibility of one syntax token linking to multiple documentation entries. Those could all be tagged with @[tactic_alt] though, and so we can decide that linking to the first entry with that token would be sufficient.

In fact, how about a linter that complains when we have two tactics with the same leading token and no @[tactic_alt]?

how about a linter that complains when we have two tactics with the same leading token and no @[tactic_alt]?

Sounds great to me!

Maybe this is already the design you're thinking of, but such a linter can probably be pretty efficient (while still being a syntax linter) by just peeking in the relevant parser extension at the end of the file! :) (And we can still log a nice message by looking at the declaration range :) )
@Thomas Murrills Could this be demonstrated during an upcoming Meta Cafe? I worked on this a bit earlier but wasn't quite connecting the dots on how to get nice reporting.
Oh, so run it only once per file by only activating on end of file syntax? I hadn't considered this idea, thanks for the suggestion!
(How does it interact with disabling the linter through set_option?)

Anne Baanen said:

(How does it interact with disabling the linter through set_option?)

Ooh, maybe this would be a use case for a ModuleLinter getting fed the entire module's syntax. When reporting a violation, process the module's top-level set_options up to the location of the declaration, and any set_option in's wrapping it, then decide whether to proceed with reporting?

...Admittedly a bit clunky, but I can imagine this being more generally useful for ModuleLinters (and iirc "process the file up to a point" is the intended behavior), so maybe it's an opportunity to make some API :)
Here's a PR to doc-gen which would allow linkification based on user-visible names: doc-gen4#395
With the doc-gen PR merged, tactic#simp should now link to the Lean 4 documentation!
